title: Oregon Chief Justice Order 2019-068 — Order Temporarily Closing the Oregon eCourt Due to a System Upgrade
text:
In the Matter of Temporary Closure of the Appellate eFiling System Due to System Upgrade
CHIEF JUSTICE ORDER No. 19-068
ORDER TEMPORARILY CLOSING THE APPELLATE eFILING SYSTEM DUE TO A SYSTEM UPGRADE

This Chief Justice Order closes the Oregon appellate courts' eFiling system at 6:00 p.m. on Friday, October 4, 2019, and reopens that system at 7:00 a.m. on Monday, October 7, 2019, which, under ORS 174.120(3), extends the computation of time for determining whether a filer has complied with a statutory time limitation governing an act to the end of normal filing hours on Monday, October 7, 2019.
I HEREBY FIND the following:
1. Beginning on Friday, October 4, 2019, at 6:00 p.m., through Monday, October 7, 2019, at 7:00 a.m., the appellate courts' eFiling system will be unavailable, due to a system upgrade.
2. Pursuant to ORAP 16.25(1), the normal daily deadline for electronic filing in the appellate courts is 11:59:59 p.m.
3. Because the appellate eFiling system will be closed before 11:59:59 p.m. on the last day for the computation of time for the completion of an act under ORS 174.120(2), the computation of time for the completion of the act is extended to the end of the next day that the court is open to the public under ORS 174.120(3).

I HEREBY ORDER, pursuant to ORS 1.002, that:
The appellate eFiling system will close at 6:00 p.m. on Friday, October 4, 2019, and will reopen at 7:00 a.m. on Monday, October 7, 2019.
This order takes effect immediately.
Dated this 25th day of September, 2019.
